links.outcome: Feasibility of monitoring clinician edit intensity of AI scribe notes over time
links.effect: Clinical edit intensity ≥1 had 88.9% PPV for clinically meaningful editing; EWMA control charts detected editing changes coinciding with system-wide rollout across 268,379 encounters.
links.quote: Longitudinal monitoring detected changes coinciding with system-wide rollout.
